matching: Case insensitive. Listed Cyrillic characters match anywhere. Listed words match when not adjacent to a Unicode letter, including in quotes, code, mixed-language prose, URLs and hyphenated expressions.

url_safety.scheme: Only HTTPS is accepted by safeExternalUrl.
url_safety.credentials: Nonempty URL username or password rejected.
url_safety.malformed: Unparseable URL or out-of-range IPv4 component rejected.
url_safety.unexpected_false_positive: fc/fd prefix checks are applied to all hostnames, not only IPv6. fda.gov and fcbarcelona.com are currently rejected.
url_safety.body_extraction: Only lowercase http:// or https:// spans are extracted from message bodies; direct source metadata URLs are parsed separately.

application: Both Codex and Claude generated message bodies before commit
Source titles, claims and URLs before keeping source metadata
Backup/restore text fields and source metadata
failure_behavior: A blocked owner message is refused. A blocked generated body receives one same-role correction attempt, then the run pauses after a repeated failure. Invalid structured source entries are discarded; they do not always reject otherwise accepted prose.

patterns: XML opening markers: invoke, parameter, tool, tool_use, tool_result (optional whitespace after <; word boundary after marker)
Whole ASCII-word-boundary tokens tool_use or tool_result
separate_tool_trace_filter.effect: Rejected provider output, separate from language classification.

limitations: This is a fixed substring/word blacklist, not comprehensive language identification.
It does not inspect source ownership or the complete language of each cited page.
Bare domains without a URL scheme are not extracted by the message URL scan.
Last deployed host revision is not reverified by this inventory.
The valid Ukrainian word які is no longer on this list after commit 909c771.
